article_content: Prince Charles demonstrated his versatility today by engaging in veterinary work during a visit to North Highland College in Caithness. Skillfully handling a stethoscope, the prince was guided through checking for heart issues with the help of a Jack Russell terrier named Jasper. Not stopping there, the Prince of Wales—known as the Duke of Rothesay in Scotland—repeated the exercise with a dapple grey Highland pony named Matthew. Charles seemed comfortable around horses, appearing relaxed and content as he conversed with Matthew's handler, Alastair Maitheson, and affectionately patted the spirited pony. This close interaction with animals occurred during his visit to North Highland College in Halkirk, part of a quick one-day trip to the north. The college, which has around 8,000 students, focuses on country skills, offering courses in gamekeeping and veterinary studies. Prince Charles, though not a vet, is well-versed in rural matters and employs several gamekeepers and farm managers. He is also a strong advocate for organic practices and runs a sustainable farming summer school at his Highgrove Estate. However, his busy schedule has kept him away from his Gloucestershire home recently, with engagements ranging from a Norfolk flower show with the Duchess of Cornwall to meeting workers at GCHQ Scarborough, where he viewed an original Enigma machine and participated in a plaque unveiling ceremony.

article_content: Dr. Thierry Costa, a physician on one of France's top reality TV shows, took his own life barely a week after a contestant passed away from a heart attack. The incident occurred in Cambodia, where the French version of Survivor, known as Koh-Lanta, was being filmed. The show had been paused following the tragic death of contestant Gérald Babin, as reported by the TF1 television channel. In a suicide note published on TF1's website, Dr. Costa expressed his distress over what he perceived as 'unfair accusations and assumptions' made by the media regarding his treatment of Babin. Some media outlets had questioned the timeliness of the medical response to Babin's collapse. 'In recent days, my reputation has been damaged in the media,' Dr. Costa wrote. He emphasized his dedication to medicine and his patients over the past 20 years, stating that false articles had ruined his efforts. He felt he could no longer face people in France without feeling their mistrust. Dr. Costa, an emergency medicine specialist, had been part of France's longest-running reality show for four seasons. The show involves contestants surviving on an uninhabited island and competing in various challenges. Prosecutors in Creteil, a Paris suburb, initiated a preliminary investigation into Babin's death. The 25-year-old contestant fell ill during a tug-of-war challenge and was airlifted to a hospital but suffered multiple heart attacks en route and was pronounced dead. Adventure Line Productions, the show's producer, confirmed that Babin had undergone a medical examination before joining the show. Koh-Lanta, which has been airing on TF1 since 2001, averaged 7.4 million viewers in its latest season. The show's filming was suspended, and the current season was canceled following Babin's death.

article_content: In a thrilling World Cup semifinal at Eden Gardens, Australia secured a hard-fought three-wicket victory over South Africa, setting up a final showdown with hosts India this Sunday in Ahmedabad. David Miller's heroic 101 off 116 balls rescued South Africa from an early collapse, pushing their total to 212 all out. Despite a shaky start, Australia completed the chase with 16 balls remaining, thanks to significant contributions from Travis Head and David Warner. Miller's innings, which included eight fours and five sixes, was crucial after South Africa lost four quick wickets. Opting to bat first, South Africa struggled early on, with openers Quinton de Kock and Temba Bavuma dismissed cheaply. Rassie van der Dussen and Aiden Markram also fell quickly, leaving South Africa at 24/4. A 95-run partnership between Miller and Heinrich Klaasen stabilized the innings before Australia struck back. In response, Australia's opening pair of Head and Warner set a strong foundation with a 60-run stand. Despite some middle-order hiccups, Australia managed to reach the target. Brief scores: South Africa 212 all out (David Miller 101, Heinrich Klaasen 47; Pat Cummins 3/51, Mitchell Starc 3/34, Josh Hazlewood 2/12); Australia 215/7 (Travis Head 62; Tabraiz Shamsi 2/42, Gerald Coetzee 2/47, Keshav Maharaj 1/24).

article_content: (CNN) -- Manchester City moved three points clear at the top of the English Premier League with a convincing 3-0 home win over sixth-placed Liverpool on Tuesday. Goals from Sergio Aguero, Yaya Toure, and a James Milner penalty put City ahead of second-placed local rivals Manchester United, who visit Newcastle on Wednesday. Roberto Mancini's men survived the second-half dismissal of Gareth Barry in the 73rd minute and even added to their tally as Martin Skrtel pulled down Toure and Milner converted from the spot. It completed a miserable evening for Liverpool, who were missing striker Luis Suarez after club officials confirmed before the match they would not appeal his eight-match ban for racially abusing Patrice Evra. Liverpool decided against a Suarez appeal. City suffered a shock 1-0 defeat at Sunderland on Sunday but went ahead after just 10 minutes as Argentina star Aguero beat Liverpool goalkeeper Pepe Reina with a dipping shot he might have saved. Liverpool pressed hard for an equalizer but fell further behind on 33 minutes as the excellent Toure headed home David Silva's corner at the near post. Reds manager Kenny Dalglish introduced Steven Gerrard and Craig Bellamy from the bench in the second half, but it was to no avail as City continued to control the match even when a man down. City captain Vincent Kompany said his team had shown great character after the Sunderland defeat. 'It was massive for us; we didn't deserve to lose against Sunderland but we were incredibly efficient today,' Kompany told Sky Sports. In Tuesday's other games, third-placed Tottenham Hotspur beat West Bromwich Albion 1-0 while Sunderland continued to impress under new manager Martin O'Neill with a 4-1 win at struggling Wigan. Tottenham moved to within three points of United after striker Jermain Defoe scored the only goal on 63 minutes at White Hart Lane. Sunderland won for the fourth time in six games since O'Neill took charge, moving up to 10th in the table.

PUBLISHED: 07:55 EST, 16 October 2013 | UPDATED: 08:52 EST, 16 October 2013 Accused: David Carrender, 49, allegedly killed his son by shooting him six times after a fight over watching football. A father is accused of killing his son after an argument over watching football escalated into a deadly shooting spree. David Carrender, 49, allegedly shot his 19-year-old son, Wyatt Carrender, six times at the family home in Martinsville, Indiana. The two men had been out together watching a football match at a restaurant or bar, according to Morgan County Sheriff Robert Downey, quoted in IndyStar.com. The pair started arguing about whether to leave or not—the father wanted to stay, but the son wanted to go home, the Sheriff said. According to the news service, the father had allegedly been drinking, and once the family got home, the two men continued their fight. 'It appears the father retrieved a handgun and shot his son, it appears, six times,' Sheriff Downey told the local news service. At the time of the shooting, the father's and son's girlfriends were with them, Downey told IndyStar.com. David Carrender, of Crooked Creek Drive, Morgan County, has no previous arrest record, the news service said. Although his son's vehicle was registered at a Bloomington, Morgan County address, it is thought he had been living with his father. Charges are expected to be filed against David Carrender this week. A post-mortem examination is being carried out on the son's body. Read more here: Football argument prompted dad's fatal shooting of teenage son, Morgan County sheriff says.

article_content: A woman was ordered to stand trial in Australia today, accused of breaking into a man’s home and raping him. Rebecca Helen Elder, 39, pleaded not guilty to one count of aggravated serious criminal trespass and one count of rape. She appeared in Adelaide’s District Court this morning. Elder, from Parkside, is accused of entering a man’s home unlawfully between September 20 and September 23, 2022, with the intent to commit rape. Prosecutors allege that she performed oral sex on the man without his consent. Judge Wayne Chivell remanded Elder on continuing bail until a directions hearing next month. article_content: For those fortunate enough to live near the world's best beaches, a quick dip in the ocean is always an option. Others can enjoy the thrill of riding the greatest waves whenever they please. However, for those who live further inland or prefer freshwater fun, there are still plenty of watery adventures to be had at some of the world's best water parks. Aquatica (Orlando, Florida) One enormous wave pool wasn't enough for the creators of Aquatica, so they built two side by side. The Dolphin Plunge water slide takes passengers on a thrilling ride through a dolphin-filled aquarium, while the Omaka Rocka challenges riders with a series of flumes and funnels. The park also features a sandy beach covered with 1,360 tons of soft, white sand and South Seas-inspired gardens with over 60,000 plant species. Aquatica, 5800 Water Play Way, Orlando, Florida; +1 888 800 5447. Aquaventure Waterpark (Dubai, UAE) As of 2013, this Middle Eastern water park boasts the world's widest water slide, the region's longest river ride (2.3 kilometers), and the longest zip line in the Middle East. Other attractions include several water coasters, a 2,296-foot-long private beach, and the Shark Lagoon, where visitors can hand-feed rays. Aquaventure, Crescent Road, The Palm, Dubai, UAE; +971 4 426 0000. Area 47 (Innsbruck, Austria) Set on an Alpine lake, this outdoor water park operates from April to the end of September. It features water rides, a diving tower, and a hydro-speed slide. On land, visitors can enjoy a high-ropes course, bridge swing, and climbing wall. Area 47, Ötztaler Achstrasse 1, Ötztal Bahnhof, Austria; +43 5266 8 76 76. Related: Top water parks of the United States. Beach Park (Fortaleza, Brazil) Beach Park's most famous ride is Insano, the world's tallest (135 feet) and fastest (65 mph) water slide. Equally thrilling is Kalafrio, a giant half-pipe slide. Younger visitors can enjoy an enormous big top-themed play area or the Acqua Show, featuring water cannons, synchronized water jets, and eight water slides just for kids. Beach Park, Rua Porto das Dunas, Fortaleza, Brazil; +55 85 4012 3000. Caribbean Bay (Gyeonggi-do, South Korea) This South Korean water park features four looping water slides and an enormous wave pool, along with traditional attractions like hot spring pools. Tired visitors can take a power nap in one of the park's sleeping rooms, equipped with purified air and beds made from energy-boosting jade. Caribanean Bay, 310 Jeondae-Ri, Pogok-eup, Cheoin-gu, Yongin-si, Gyeonggi-do, South Korea; +82 2 759 1940 7. Siam Park (Tenerife, Spain) Siam Park is a Thai-themed water park on the island of Tenerife. Its most popular ride is the 91-foot-high Tower of Power, where riders plunge down a vertical drop before shooting through an aquarium filled with stingrays and sharks. The park also offers a lazy river and surf lessons in the wave pool. Siam Park, Avenida Siam Park, Costa Adeje, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain; +34 902 060 000. Tropical Islands (Krausnick, Germany) Housed inside the world's largest free-standing hall, Tropical Islands can accommodate 6,000 visitors a day. It features one of the world's largest indoor pools, a rainforest with 50,000 plants, a hotel, and a nightclub. Visitors can even take a balloon ride without stepping outside. Tropical Islands, Tropical-Islands-Allee 1, Germany; +49 35477 605050. Watercube Waterpark (Beijing) All rides at Watercube Waterpark were designed overseas and shipped in. Highlights include the funnel-shaped Tornado ride, Aqualoop slide, and Bulletbowl. Visitors can also admire the enormous jellyfish and clouds of bubbles suspended from the ceiling. Happy Magic Watercube, Olympic Park, BeiChen Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing; +86 010 8437 2030. WaterWorld Waterpark (Ayia Napa, Cyprus) Foam parties aren't the only way to cool off in Ayia Napa. WaterWorld Water Park has a Grecian theme with pillars and Trojan horse-shaped monuments. Poseidon's Wave Pool features Greek ruins, geysers, and shipwrecks, while the Drop to Atlantis shoots riders out of an enormous Roman temple. WaterWorld Waterpark, 18 Ayia Thekla Road, Ayia Napa, Cyprus; +357 23 724444. Wet 'n Wild (Orlando, Florida) Visitors are spoiled for choice at Wet 'n Wild. In addition to various thrilling water rides, there's a huge sandcastle-themed children's area, a wave pool, and a lazy river. One of the most popular rides is Disco H20, where passengers float along to a soundtrack of 1970s hits accompanied by disco balls and flashing lights. Wet 'n Wild, 6200 International Drive, Orlando, Florida; +1 407 351 1800. World Waterpark (Alberta, Canada) Located inside Alberta's West Edmonton Mall, this is the world's second-largest indoor water park. It features the world's largest indoor wave pool with 2.7 million gallons of water. Attractions include a looping water slide and Blue Thunder, a bungee jump tower suspended over the wave pool. World Waterpark, 1755, 8882 170 St., Edmonton, Canada; +1 780 444 5313. Yas Waterworld (Abu Dhabi, UAE) Opened in 2013, Yas Waterworld offers 43 rides and attractions, including five unique water slides. Highlights include Dawwama, the world's first hydro-magnetic-powered water slide, and the Bandit Bomber, a 1,804-foot-long water coaster. Visitors can also try the world's largest FlowBarrel surf simulator or the Liwa Loop, the Middle East's only looping water slide. Yas Waterworld, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE; +971 2 414 2000.
translated_content: Per chi è abbastanza fortunato da vivere vicino alle migliori spiagge del mondo, un tuffo veloce nell'oceano è sempre un'opzione. Lo scivolo d'acqua Dolphin Plunge porta i passeggeri in un emozionante viaggio attraverso un acquario pieno di delfini, mentre l'Omaka Rocka sfida i cavalieri con una serie di condotte e imbuti. Il parco presenta anche una spiaggia sabbiosa coperta da 1.360 tonnellate di sabbia bianca morbida e giardini ispirati ai Mari del Sud con oltre 60.000 specie di piante. Aquatica, 5800 Water Play Way, Orlando, Florida; +1 888 800 5447. Aquaventure Waterpark (Dubai, UAE) A partire dal 2013, questo parco acquatico del Medio Oriente vanta lo scivolo d'acqua più largo del mondo, il giro in fiume più lungo della regione (2,3 chilometri) e la zip line più lunga del Medio Oriente. Altre attrazioni includono diversi acquascivoli, una spiaggia privata lunga 2.296 piedi e la Laguna degli Squali, dove i visitatori possono dare da mangiare a mano alle razze. Aquaventure, Crescent Road, The Palm, Dubai, UAE; +971 4 426 0000. Area 47 (Innsbruck, Austria) Situato su un lago alpino, questo parco acquatico all'aperto opera da aprile alla fine di settembre. Offre giostre acquatiche, una torre per tuffi e uno scivolo hydro-speed. Sulla terraferma, i visitatori possono godere di un percorso ad alta fune, uno swing sul ponte e una parete da arrampicata. Area 47, Ötztaler Achstrasse 1, Ötztal Bahnhof, Austria; +43 5266 8 76 76. Related: I migliori parchi acquatici degli Stati Uniti. Beach Park (Fortaleza, Brazil) La giostra più famosa di Beach Park è Insano, lo scivolo d'acqua più alto (135 piedi) e più veloce (65 mph) del mondo. altrettanto emozionante è Kalafrio, uno scivolo a mezza pipa gigante. I visitatori più giovani possono godere di un'enorme area giochi a tema tendone o dello spettacolo Acqua, con cannoni ad acqua, getti d'acqua sincronizzati e otto scivoli d'acqua solo per bambini. Beach Park, Rua Porto das Dunas, Fortaleza, Brazil; +55 85 4012 3000. Caribbean Bay (Gyeonggi-do, South Korea) Questo parco acquatico sudcoreano presenta quattro scivoli d'acqua ad anello e un'enorme piscina a onde, insieme a tradizionali attrazioni come piscine termali. I visitatori stanchi possono fare un pisolino in una delle stanze del sonno del parco, attrezzate con aria purificata e letti realizzati con giada energizzante. Caribbean Bay, 310 Jeondae-Ri, Pogok-eup, Cheoin-gu, Yongin-si, Gyeonggi-do, South Korea; +82 2 759 1940 7. Siam Park (Tenerife, Spain) Siam Park è un parco acquatico a tema thailandese sull'isola di Tenerife. La sua giostra più popolare è la Torre del Potere alta 91 piedi, dove i cavalieri si tuffano in una caduta verticale prima di sparare attraverso un acquario pieno di razze e squali. Il parco offre anche un fiume lento e lezioni di surf nella piscina a onde. Siam Park, Avenida Siam Park, Costa Adeje, Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Spain; +34 902 060 000. Tropical Islands (Krausnick, Germany) Alloggiato all'interno della più grande sala autoportante del mondo, Tropical Islands può ospitare 6.000 visitatori al giorno. Presenta una delle più grandi piscine coperte del mondo, una foresta pluviale con 50.000 piante, un hotel e una discoteca. I visitatori possono anche fare un giro in mongolfiera senza uscire. Tropical Islands, Tropical-Islands-Allee 1, Germany; +49 35477 605050. Watercube Waterpark (Beijing) Tutte le giostre di Watercube Waterpark sono state progettate all'estero e spedite. Le attrazioni principali includono il giro a imbuto Tornado, lo scivolo Aqualoop e Bulletbowl. I visitatori possono anche ammirare le enormi meduse e le nuvole di bolle sospese al soffitto. Happy Magic Watercube, Olympic Park, BeiChen Road, Chaoyang District, Beijing; +86 010 8437 2030. WaterWorld Waterpark (Ayia Napa, Cyprus) Le feste di schiuma non sono l'unico modo per rinfrescarsi ad Ayia Napa. WaterWorld Water Park ha un tema greco con colonne e monumenti a forma di cavallo di Troia. La Piscina a Onde di Poseidone presenta rovine greche, geyser e naufragi, mentre la Caduta ad Atlantide spara i cavalieri fuori da un enorme tempio romano. WaterWorld Waterpark, 18 Ayia Thekla Road, Ayia Napa, Cyprus; +357 23 724444. Wet 'n Wild (Orlando, Florida) I visitatori sono viziati per la scelta a Wet 'n Wild. Oltre a varie giostre acquatiche emozionanti, c'è un'enorme area giochi per bambini a tema castello di sabbia, una piscina a onde e un fiume lento. Una delle giostre più popolari è Disco H20, dove i passeggeri galleggiano al ritmo di una colonna sonora di successi degli anni '70 accompagnati da sfere stroboscopiche e luci lampeggianti. Wet 'n Wild, 6200 International Drive, Orlando, Florida; +1 407 351 1800. World Waterpark (Alberta, Canada) Situato all'interno del West Edmonton Mall dell'Alberta, questo è il secondo parco acquatico coperto più grande del mondo. Presenta la più grande piscina a onde coperta del mondo con 2,7 milioni di galloni d'acqua. Le attrazioni includono uno scivolo d'acqua ad anello e Blue Thunder, una torre di bungee jumping sospesa sopra la piscina a onde. World Waterpark, 1755, 8882 170 St., Edmonton, Canada; +1 780 444 5313. Yas Waterworld (Abu Dhabi, UAE) Aperto nel 2013, Yas Waterworld offre 43 giostre e attrazioni, tra cui cinque scivoli d'acqua unici. Le attrazioni principali includono Dawwama, il primo scivolo d'acqua al mondo alimentato idromagneticamente, e il Bandit Bomber, un acquascivolo lungo 1.804 piedi. I visitatori possono anche provare il più grande simulatore di surf FlowBarrel del mondo o il Liwa Loop, l'unico scivolo d'acqua ad anello del Medio Oriente. Yas Waterworld, Yas Island, Abu Dhabi, UAE; +971 2 414 2000.
